en.title: Taika Waititi's Star Wars Film Officially 'On Ice,' Director Confirms
en.summary: Taika Waititi has confirmed that his long-anticipated Star Wars film is on hold indefinitely. The director shared the news while promoting his latest project, leaving fans to wonder about the future of his galaxy far, far away.
en.body:
The dream of seeing **Taika Waititi**'s unique brand of humor and heartfelt storytelling in the Star Wars universe has been put on pause. The beloved director, known for his distinctive style in films like *Thor: Ragnarok* and *Jojo Rabbit*, has confirmed that his Star Wars movie, which has been in development since 2020, is now "on ice" indefinitely.

Waititi shared this bittersweet update while promoting his latest film, *Klara and the Sun*. When asked about the status of his Star Wars project, he did not mince words. "I hate to break this to you, but we’re going to actually put it on ice and we’re working on a different thing together," Waititi told Inverse. He further elaborated that the project is "very iced" and that he currently has "about four other movies" he is trying to get off the ground. While the specifics of this new endeavor with screenwriter **Tony McNamara** remain under wraps, the confirmation that the Star Wars film is shelved is a significant development for fans eager to see his take on the galaxy.

## A Galaxy Far, Far Away Just Got Colder

This news is sure to send ripples through the dedicated Star Wars fandom. For years, the prospect of a Waititi-helmed Star Wars film has been a source of excitement, promising a fresh perspective on the iconic saga. His involvement was announced back in 2020, and the director had previously expressed his enthusiasm, even mentioning that he was working on the script with **Tony McNamara**, who also penned *The Favourite* and *Cruella*. The indefinite hold suggests that the ambitious project, which was expected to be a significant departure from previous Star Wars entries, is unlikely to materialize anytime soon. The director's publicist reportedly advised him to say no more about the shelved project, adding an extra layer of mystery to the situation.

## What Does This Mean for Star Wars and Waititi?

The Star Wars galaxy is vast and ever-expanding, with numerous projects in various stages of development, including shows like *The Acolyte* and films from **Dave Filoni** and **Sharmeen Obaid-Chinoy**. Waititi's project was always positioned as something potentially experimental, an opportunity to explore uncharted territory within the established lore. Its indefinite postponement raises questions about the future direction of Star Wars cinema and the studio's willingness to greenlight more auteur-driven projects within the franchise. For Waititi himself, this means shifting focus to his other burgeoning projects, keeping fans engaged with his prolific output across different genres and stories. The Star Wars galaxy will continue to evolve, but for now, Waititi's unique voice will be heard elsewhere.

## What's Next

While the Star Wars film is on hold, **Taika Waititi** is actively developing other projects. Fans can anticipate his continued work in film and television, with details on his upcoming slate expected to be announced in the coming months. The Star Wars universe, meanwhile, will press forward with its existing slate of announced films and series.
